# KANJIDIC2

Copyright James William BREEN and the Electronic Dictionary Research and
Development Group. CC BY-SA 4.0:
https://www.edrdg.org/edrdg/licence.html

Source documentation: https://www.edrdg.org/kanjidic/kanjidic2_ov_legacy.html
JSON redistribution: scriptin/jmdict-simplified, pinned release
3.6.2+20260831182826. Exact archive URL/hash are in `source.json`.

Changes: select character frequency ranks 1–500 and complete Japanese on/kun
readings without dotted okurigana or affix markers; derive Romanized keys using
pinned WanaKana. No names, non-Japanese readings, SKIP codes or dictionary indexes
are incorporated in the runtime derivative. Original source remains available
here; the derived Japanese character asset retains CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution.

Newspaper character frequency is not modern conversation or reading frequency.
This file supplies characters, not inferred words or Japanese sentence grammar.
